description: The prop and event pair that `v-model` expands to on a component.
Vue 3.4+ macro returning a ref that reads the model prop and emits `update:*` when written.
`defineModel('title')` pairs with `v-model:title` in the parent; a component can have several.
`const [model, modifiers] = defineModel()` exposes modifiers like `.trim` used by the parent.
